description: Predict the gender behind a first or full name with Genderize - one name or a batch, each answer scored with a confidence and the number of records behind it.

api.description: Predict gender for several names at once, answered in the same order. A batch counts each name against the monthly quota, and `country_id` applies to every name in it

fields.description: Up to 100 names to predict, answered in the same order. A batch counts each name against the monthly quota
Applies to every name in the batch, not one of them

output.type: { name: string, gender: string | null, probability: number, count: number, country_id?: string }[]

api.description: Predict the gender behind a first or full name, with a confidence score and the number of records behind it. Scoping by country changes the answer for names such as Kim or Andrea

fields.description: A first name or a full name. A full name is more accurate, because every part of it carries signal
Scope the prediction to one country, which matters for names such as Kim or Andrea
